 Rage Charge is a Barbarian class-specific resource.

Gaining Rage Charges

Barbarians start with 2 Rage Charges and gain more as additional levels are put into the class, eventually reaching a maximum of 5 Rage Charges at level 12. Replenished by long rest.

7th

12th 5


Rage Charges can also be gained as a Level 6 Druid by using the class action  Wild Shape: Owlbear. Doing so grants 3x Rage Charges which can be used to power the  Enrage ability, or kept for later use if multiclassed as a Barbarian.

Actions using Rage Charges

Rage charges are used by Barbarians to enter  Rage or a subclass' alternative to rage. Additionally some non-barbarian creatures may have rage charges to use similar effects, such as an Owlbear Wildshaped Druid's  Enrage.
